import json
before=current_frame.ascii
def bbox_of(fr,ch):
    a=fr.ascii.splitlines()
    px=[(r,c) for r,l in enumerate(a) for c,x in enumerate(l) if x==ch]
    if not px: return None
    return (min(p[0] for p in px),max(p[0] for p in px),min(p[1] for p in px),max(p[1] for p in px),len(px))
print('before c count:', before.count('c'))

print('after c count:', fr.ascii.count('c'))
# diff B bboxes
from collections import deque
def comps(fr,ch):
    a=fr.ascii.splitlines(); seen=[[False]*len(a[0]) for _ in a]; out=[]
    for r in range(len(a)):
        for c0 in range(len(a[0])):
            if a[r][c0]==ch and not seen[r][c0]:
                q=deque([(r,c0)]); seen[r][c0]=True; comp=[]
                while q:
                    r0,c1=q.popleft(); comp.append((r0,c1))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        r2,c2=r0+dr,c1+dc
                        if 0<=r2<len(a) and 0<=c2<len(a[0]) and a[r2][c2]==ch and not seen[r2][c2]:
                            seen[r2][c2]=True; q.append((r2,c2))
                out.append((min(p[0] for p in comp),max(p[0] for p in comp),min(p[1] for p in comp),max(p[1] for p in comp),len(comp)))
    return out
print('B before:', comps(before_frame if False else type('x',(),{'ascii':before})(),'B'))
print('B after :', comps(fr,'B'))
print('Y after :', [c for c in comps(fr,'Y') if c[3]<63])

from collections import deque
def comps(fr,ch):
    a=fr.ascii.splitlines(); seen=[[False]*len(a[0]) for _ in a]; out=[]
    for r in range(len(a)):
        for c0 in range(len(a[0])):
            if a[r][c0]==ch and not seen[r][c0]:
                q=deque([(r,c0)]); seen[r][c0]=True; comp=[]
                while q:
                    r0,c1=q.popleft(); comp.append((r0,c1))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        r2,c2=r0+dr,c1+dc
                        if 0<=r2<len(a) and 0<=c2<len(a[0]) and a[r2][c2]==ch and not seen[r2][c2]:
                            seen[r2][c2]=True; q.append((r2,c2))
                out.append((min(p[0] for p in comp),max(p[0] for p in comp),min(p[1] for p in comp),max(p[1] for p in comp),len(comp)))
    return out
